Gideon's 1 Jul post in #strategic-pod (09:17) says he closed ticket #8841 with support. The fix was clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, done by their IT. The standard template worked for their billing dept after that.

I replied in the thread. The 30 Sep and 4 May strategic digests describe #8841 differently (a Dock Door 14 check-in escalation and an Allentown kiosk timeout), so check the ticket itself before the QBR relies on it.
